biggest_cut: In the proof of Lemma 3, I would compress the passage from the grid bound to the whole circle (maximum principle on the reversed polynomial, then Cauchy's estimate and integration along the arc) into a single citation of the standard Bernstein/Marcinkiewicz–Zygmund sampling inequality. I would also drop the repeated restatements: properties (32)–(33) repeat (15)–(16), the definition of K_δ appears twice, and the closing remarks about divisibility of N, uniformity and why μ=0 is a trivial case all say the same things again.
